JwtResponse.description: Response containing the JWT authentication token

CustomerDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Customer information

customerReferenceId.description: External client reference ID for the customer

source.description: Source of customer creation: MANUAL, EVENT_AUTO_CREATED, or STRIPE_IMPORTED

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer record was last modified

InvoiceDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Invoice information

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice was last modified

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the invoice

items.description: Line items for this invoice (only populated on detail endpoint)

PlanDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Plan information

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the plan was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the plan was last modified

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the plan

SubscribedCustomerResponse.description: Response after a customer has successfully subscribed

invoice.description: Details of the first invoice generated

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the subscription process

checkoutUrl.description: Stripe Checkout URL for payment (IN_ADVANCE plans in STRIPE_INTEGRATION mode)

SubscriptionDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Subscription information

isActive.description: Status indicating if the subscription is active

gracePeriodDays.description: Number of grace period days for payment

currentPeriodStart.description: Timestamp when the current period started

currentPeriodEnd.description: Timestamp when the current period ends

cancelEffectiveAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation becomes effective

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was cancelled

billingAnchorDay.description: Billing anchor day of the month

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the subscription

SubscriptionScheduledChangeDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Subscription Scheduled Change information

id.description: Unique identifier of the scheduled change

type.description: Type of scheduled change (e.g., UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE)

subscriptionId.description: ID of the subscription this change applies to

effectiveAt.description: Timestamp when the change becomes effective

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the change was created

value.description: Configuration values for the rule. For usage-based billing, include 'model': 'usage', 'price_per_unit', and 'usage_unit_type'. Optionally add a cost model for COGS tracking with 'cost_model': 'simple' and 'cost_per_unit'.

PlanFeatureRuleDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Plan-Feature link rules

value.description: Configuration values for the rule. For usage-based billing, include 'model': 'usage' and 'price_per_unit'.

enabled.description: Status indicating if the rule is enabled

creditModelId.description: ID of the linked credit model

creditModelName.description: Name of the linked credit model

creditDenomination.description: Denomination of the linked credit model

FeatureDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Feature information

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the feature was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the feature was last modified

isEnabled.description: Status indicating if the feature is enabled

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the feature

CreditTransactionDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Credit Transaction (ledger entry)

creditPoolId.description: Credit pool this transaction belongs to

creditGrantId.description: Grant consumed by this transaction, if applicable

transactionType.description: Transaction type: GRANT, DEDUCTION, EXPIRATION, REVERSAL, ADJUSTMENT

amount.description: Signed amount: positive for grants, negative for deductions

reversedTransactionId.description: ID of the reversed transaction, if this is a reversal

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was created

CreateCreditPoolRequest.description: Request to create a new credit pool

currency.description: ISO currency code when denomination is monetary

hardLimit.description: When true, zero balance blocks feature access

rolloverCap.description: Max credits to roll over when policy is CAPPED

CreditPoolDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Credit Pool information

id.description: Unique identifier of the credit pool

currency.description: ISO currency code when denomination is monetary

hardLimit.description: When true, zero balance blocks feature access

status.description: Pool status: ACTIVE, FROZEN, DEPLETED, ARCHIVED

rolloverCap.description: Max credits to roll over when policy is CAPPED

customerId.description: Customer ID if pool is customer-scoped

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the pool was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the pool was last modified

CreateCreditModelRequest.description: Request to create a new credit model

hardLimit.description: When true, zero balance blocks feature access

rolloverCap.description: Max credits to roll over when policy is CAPPED

CreditModelDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Credit Model information

id.description: Unique identifier of the credit model

hardLimit.description: When true, zero balance blocks feature access

rolloverCap.description: Max credits to roll over when policy is CAPPED

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the model was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the model was last modified

CreditGrantRequest.description: Request to grant credits to a pool

creditPoolId.description: Credit pool ID to grant credits to

grantType.description: Grant type: PLAN_INCLUDED, PURCHASED, PROMOTIONAL, REFUND, SYSTEM, ROLLOVER, MANUAL

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate grants

CreditGrantDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Credit Grant information

creditPoolId.description: Credit pool this grant belongs to

subscriptionId.description: Subscription that triggered this grant, if any

invoiceId.description: Invoice linked to this grant, if purchased

grantType.description: Grant type: PLAN_INCLUDED, PURCHASED, PROMOTIONAL, etc.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the grant was created

CreditDeductionRequest.description: Request to deduct credits from a pool

creditPoolId.description: Credit pool ID to deduct from

eventId.description: Usage event that triggered this deduction

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate deductions

SubscribeToPlanRequest.description: Request to subscribe the account to a plan

planId.description: The UUID of the plan to subscribe to

AccountApiKeyResponse.description: Response containing the account's API key

keyType.description: The type of the API key

EventDto.description: Data Transfer Object for EventDto information

accountId.description: Account identifier associated with the event

flowId.description: Flow identifier associated with the event

customerId.description: Customer identifier (UUID) associated with the event

customerReferenceId.description: Customer reference ID (external identifier) associated with the event. Use this if you don't have the Tanso customer UUID.

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe customer ID (cus_...). Resolves customer via the stripe_customers bridge table.

featureKey.description: The key of the feature this event tracks usage for. Transient — not persisted.

featureId.description: Feature identifier associated with the event

subscriptionId.description: Subscription identifier associated with the event

entitlementId.description: Entitlement identifier associated with the event

invoiceId.description: Invoice identifier associated with the event

costAmount.description: Cost amount associated with the event

costUnit.description: Unit of the cost amount (e.g. USD, credits)

revenueUnit.description: Unit of the revenue amount (e.g. USD, credits)

usageUnits.description: Usage units (e.g., number of tokens, seconds, etc.)

usageUnitType.description: Type of usage units (e.g., tokens, api_calls, storage_gb)

inputTokens.description: Input token count for AI model cost calculation

outputTokens.description: Output token count for AI model cost calculation

properties.description: Additional properties associated with the event

customerIsNative.description: Whether the customerId references a native Tanso customer

featureIsNative.description: Whether the featureId references a native Tanso feature

subscriptionIsNative.description: Whether the subscriptionId references a native Tanso subscription

entitlementIsNative.description: Whether the entitlementId references a native Tanso entitlement

invoiceIsNative.description: Whether the invoiceId references a native Tanso invoice

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the event was last modified

eventType.description: Event type associated with the event

items.description: List of items in the current page

totalElements.description: Total number of elements across all pages

groupKey.description: The value of the grouped field

eventCount.description: Number of events in this group

totalCost.description: Total cost across events in this group

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue across events in this group

totalUsageUnits.description: Total usage units across events in this group

lastOccurredAt.description: Most recent event timestamp in this group

PlanCreditAllocationDto.description: Data Transfer Object for Plan Credit Allocation

creditAmount.description: Number of credits allocated per period

grantExpiresMonths.description: Number of months before granted credits expire

hardLimit.description: Whether to block events when credits are depleted (true) or allow overage (false). Null inherits from credit model.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the allocation was created

PlanFeatureLinkedDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a plan and its linked features

features.description: List of features linked to the plan

creditAllocations.description: Credit allocations configured for this plan

items.description: List of subscription revenue items in the current page

totalElements.description: Total number of elements across all pages

hasNext.description: Whether there are more pages after the current one

CustomerBulkResponse.description: Response containing a list of customers

CustomerElement.description: Simplified customer information for bulk display

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer was created

StripeApiKeysResponse.description: Response containing masked Stripe API keys for an account

RevenueBridgePeriodDto.description: Revenue breakdown for a single billing period

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue from all paid invoices in this period

creditAmount.description: Credit amounts applied in this period (negative)

netRevenue.description: Net revenue (totalRevenue, which already includes credits)

creditToRevenueRatio.description: Ratio of |creditAmount| to gross revenue (totalRevenue - creditAmount), null if gross is zero

customerCount.description: Number of distinct customers with paid invoices in this period

newCustomers.description: Number of customers new in this period vs the previous period

churnedCustomers.description: Number of customers in the previous period but not this one

RevenueBridgeResponseDto.description: Historical revenue bridge showing period-over-period revenue changes

periods.description: Revenue breakdown by billing period, ordered chronologically

AnalyticsResponseDto.description: Complete analytics response including portfolio summary and customer details

ChurnScoreDto.description: Composite churn risk score with signal breakdown

riskLabel.description: Risk label: low (0-25), moderate (26-50), high (51-75), critical (76-100)

totalCredits.description: Sum of all credit invoice amounts (negative value)

netEffectiveMrr.description: Net effective MRR after credits (totalEffectiveMrr + totalCredits)

creditToMrrRatio.description: Ratio of |totalCredits| to totalEffectiveMrr, null if totalEffectiveMrr is zero

CustomerAnalyticsDto.description: Analytics data for a single customer

planId.description: Unique identifier of the customer's plan

totalCost.description: Total cost from plan features in dollars

marginStatus.description: Margin health status: healthy (>=70%), at_risk (40-70%), underwater (<40%)

projectedUsageRevenue.description: Projected usage-based revenue for the current billing period

effectiveMrr.description: Effective MRR including projected usage revenue (mrr + projectedUsageRevenue)

rgp.description: Recurring gross profit (effectiveMrr - totalCost), null if no cost model

churnRisk.description: Churn risk: null, pending_cancel, or pending_downgrade

cancelEffectiveAt.description: When the cancellation takes effect, if applicable

churnScoreDetails.description: Detailed churn risk score with signal breakdown

totalCredits.description: Total credit invoice amounts for this customer, null if no credits

CustomersByStatus.description: Customer counts grouped by margin health status

healthy.description: Number of customers with healthy margins (>=70%)

atRisk.description: Number of customers with at-risk margins (40-70%)

underwater.description: Number of customers with underwater margins (<40%)

MrrByStatus.description: MRR amounts grouped by margin health status

healthy.description: MRR from customers with healthy margins

atRisk.description: MRR from customers with at-risk margins

underwater.description: MRR from customers with underwater margins

PortfolioSummaryDto.description: Summary analytics for the entire customer portfolio

totalMrr.description: Total monthly recurring revenue across all customers in dollars

totalCosts.description: Total costs across all customers in dollars

avgMargin.description: Average margin across all customers as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0)

ltv.description: Customer lifetime value (ARPU / monthly churn rate), null if churn is zero

nrr.description: Net revenue retention rate as a decimal (e.g., 1.05 = 105%), null if no historical data

pendingCancelCount.description: Number of customers with pending cancellations

pendingCancelMrr.description: MRR at risk from pending cancellations

pendingDowngradeCount.description: Number of customers with pending downgrades

totalProjectedUsageRevenue.description: Total projected usage-based revenue across all customers

totalEffectiveMrr.description: Total effective MRR including projected usage revenue (totalMrr + totalProjectedUsageRevenue)

rgpMargin.description: RGP margin (totalRgp / totalEffectiveMrr), null if totalEffectiveMrr is zero

avgChurnScore.description: Average churn risk score across scored customers

criticalChurnCount.description: Number of customers with critical churn risk (score >= 76)

highRiskMrr.description: MRR from customers with high or critical churn risk (score >= 51)

revenueBurnDown.description: Projected MRR loss over 30/60/90 day windows

topModelsByCost.description: Top models by cost across portfolio

ModelSummaryDto.description: Detailed analytics for a single LLM model

models.description: Per-model detailed analytics, sorted by cost desc

SubscriptionStatusResponse.description: Response containing the account's subscription status

hasActiveSubscription.description: Whether the account has an active subscription

planPriceAmount.description: Price amount of the active plan

planKey.description: Unique key of the active plan
